seoDescription: Buy genuine gaming consoles in Nepal: PlayStation, Xbox and Nintendo Switch, plus controllers and accessories. Cash on delivery.
seoContent:
## Buy gaming consoles in Nepal

Consoles are the simplest way to play the biggest games on your TV: no upgrades, no settings to tweak, just plug in and play. Each platform has its own strengths and exclusive games.

## Which console suits you

- PlayStation: blockbuster exclusives, a huge game library and a strong online community
- Xbox: Game Pass gives access to a large library of games for a monthly subscription, and plays well with PC
- Nintendo Switch: plays on the TV or handheld, with family-friendly Nintendo exclusives and local multiplayer

## Before you buy

- Disc or digital editions: disc versions let you buy and resell physical games
- Storage: games are large, so consider an expansion option
- Online play: most online multiplayer needs a paid subscription on each platform
- A good TV or monitor and a stable internet connection make a big difference

All consoles at 361 Gadgets are genuine.

faqs.question: Which console is best for families?
faqs.answer: The Nintendo Switch is popular with families thanks to its local multiplayer games and the option to play on the TV or as a handheld. PlayStation and Xbox also have parental controls and family-friendly games.

faqs.question: Do consoles work in Nepal?
faqs.answer: Yes. Consoles work on Nepali power with the correct plug or adapter, and online services work over a normal home internet connection. A stable connection gives the best online play.

faqs.question: Do I need internet to play?
faqs.answer: Many games can be played offline once installed, but you need internet for setup, updates, digital purchases and online multiplayer.

seoDescription: Buy genuine PlayStation consoles and accessories in Nepal: PS5, DualSense controllers and more, with nationwide delivery.
seoContent:
## Buy PlayStation in Nepal

PlayStation is home to some of the most acclaimed exclusive games, from cinematic adventures to competitive shooters and sports titles. The PlayStation 5 loads games in seconds thanks to its fast SSD and its DualSense controller adds detailed haptic feedback.

## Choosing your PlayStation

- Disc edition: buy, trade and resell physical games
- Digital edition: buy games from the PlayStation Store only
- Storage: the internal SSD fills up with large games; compatible M.2 SSDs can expand it
- Accessories: a second DualSense for multiplayer, a charging station and a headset

## Online play

Online multiplayer on PlayStation needs a PlayStation Plus subscription, which also gives monthly games. All PlayStation products we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Can I expand PS5 storage?
faqs.answer: Yes. The PS5 has an expansion slot for a compatible M.2 NVMe SSD, and you can also store and play PS4 games from a USB external drive.

faqs.question: Do PS4 games work on PS5?
faqs.answer: Most PS4 games are playable on PS5 through backward compatibility, and many receive performance improvements.

faqs.question: Do I need PlayStation Plus?
faqs.answer: You need PlayStation Plus for most online multiplayer. Single-player games and free-to-play games do not require it.

seoContent:
## Buy Xbox in Nepal

Xbox gives you powerful hardware and one of the best deals in gaming: Game Pass, a subscription library of hundreds of games. Xbox controllers also work with Windows PCs, so your accessories do double duty.

## Series X or Series S

- Xbox Series X: the most powerful model, with a disc drive and 4K gaming
- Xbox Series S: smaller, digital-only and more affordable, designed for 1080p to 1440p gaming

## What to consider

- Storage: games are large, and expansion cards add space to the internal SSD
- Game Pass: try many games without buying them individually
- Controllers: the Xbox Wireless Controller connects to Xbox, PC and phones

All Xbox products we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: What is Xbox Game Pass?
faqs.answer: Game Pass is a monthly subscription that gives you access to a large, rotating library of games on Xbox and, depending on the plan, PC and cloud gaming.

faqs.question: Can I use an Xbox controller on my PC?
faqs.answer: Yes. Xbox Wireless Controllers work with Windows PCs over USB, Bluetooth or the Xbox Wireless Adapter, and with most Android phones over Bluetooth.

faqs.question: Does the Xbox Series S play discs?
faqs.answer: No. The Series S is digital-only, so games are downloaded. The Series X has a disc drive.

seoContent:

The Nintendo Switch is a console you can play on the TV at home or take with you as a handheld. It is famous for Nintendo's own games, such as Mario, Zelda and Pokemon, and for local multiplayer that the whole family can enjoy together.

- Joy-Con controllers can be shared for two-player games straight out of the box

- A Pro Controller for longer sessions on the TV

All Nintendo Switch products we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Can two people play on one Switch?
faqs.answer: Yes. The two Joy-Con controllers can be used separately, so many games support two players straight away.

faqs.question: Does the Switch need a memory card?
faqs.answer: The internal storage fills up quickly with downloaded games. A microSD card is an easy, affordable way to add more space.

faqs.question: Is the Nintendo Switch good for kids?
faqs.answer: Yes. It has many family-friendly games and parental controls that let you set play time limits and restrict content.

seoDescription: Buy genuine game controllers in Nepal for PC, PlayStation, Xbox, Switch and mobile, wired and wireless. Delivered nationwide.
seoContent:
## Buy game controllers in Nepal

A good controller makes racing, sports, action and fighting games far more enjoyable than a keyboard or a touch screen. Many controllers work across several platforms, so one can serve your PC, console and phone.

## How to choose a controller

- Platform: official controllers give full support on their console; many third-party controllers cover PC, Switch and mobile
- Connection: Bluetooth, 2.4 GHz wireless or wired USB for the lowest latency
- Battery: rechargeable over USB-C or replaceable batteries
- Comfort and extras: grip, trigger feel, rear paddles and hall-effect sticks that resist drift
- Mobile gaming: telescopic controllers hold your phone for a console-like feel

All controllers we sell are genuine, with compatibility listed on the product page.

faqs.question: Will this controller work with my PC?
faqs.answer: Most modern controllers work with Windows PCs, and Steam supports a wide range of them. The product page lists compatible platforms.

faqs.question: What is stick drift?
faqs.answer: Stick drift is when the character or camera moves without you touching the stick, usually from wear. Controllers with hall-effect sticks use magnets instead of contact parts, which makes them more resistant to drift.

faqs.question: Can I use a controller for mobile games?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many mobile games support Bluetooth controllers, and phone-clip controllers make playing on a phone feel like a handheld console.

seoDescription: Shop genuine gaming headsets in Nepal with clear mics, surround sound and comfort for long sessions on PC, console and mobile.
seoContent:
## Buy gaming headsets in Nepal

In competitive games, sound tells you where enemies are, and a clear microphone keeps your team coordinated. A good gaming headset also needs to stay comfortable for hours.

## What to look for

- Microphone: clear voice pickup with noise reduction; detachable or flip-to-mute mics are handy
- Sound: positional audio and virtual surround help you locate footsteps and gunfire
- Comfort: weight, memory-foam ear cushions and breathable materials for long sessions
- Connection: 3.5 mm for universal compatibility, USB for PC features, 2.4 GHz wireless for freedom without lag
- Platform: check compatibility with PC, PlayStation, Xbox, Switch and mobile

All gaming headsets we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Will a gaming headset work on PS5 and Xbox?
faqs.answer: Headsets with a 3.5 mm jack work with PlayStation and Xbox controllers. Wireless headsets need to support the specific console, so check the product page.

faqs.question: Is virtual surround sound useful?
faqs.answer: It helps many players hear the direction of sounds more clearly in shooters and battle royale games, although good stereo headsets also give strong positional audio.

faqs.question: Can I use a gaming headset for online classes?
faqs.answer: Yes. A gaming headset's microphone is usually much clearer than a laptop's built-in mic, which makes it great for classes and meetings too.

seoDescription: Buy genuine gaming keyboards in Nepal: mechanical, RGB and compact keyboards with fast switches for PC gaming.
seoContent:
## Buy gaming keyboards in Nepal

A gaming keyboard registers every key press accurately, even when you hold several keys at once, and is built to survive years of intense use. Mechanical switches also give a satisfying, consistent feel.

## How to choose a gaming keyboard

- Switch type: linear (smooth and fast), tactile (a bump you can feel) or clicky (an audible click)
- Layout: full-size, tenkeyless (TKL), 75 percent or 60 percent; smaller layouts leave more room for mouse movement
- Anti-ghosting and N-key rollover for accurate multi-key presses
- Connection: wired for zero latency, or low-latency 2.4 GHz wireless
- Extras: hot-swappable switches, a detachable USB-C cable, media keys and RGB lighting

All gaming keyboards we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Which switch type is best for gaming?
faqs.answer: Linear switches are popular for fast-paced games because they are smooth with no bump. Tactile switches suit people who game and type. It comes down to personal preference.

faqs.question: What does hot-swappable mean?
faqs.answer: Hot-swappable keyboards let you pull out and replace switches without soldering, so you can try different switch types or replace a faulty one easily.

faqs.question: Is a 60 percent keyboard good for gaming?
faqs.answer: Yes. Compact keyboards free up desk space for wide mouse movements. You lose the function row and arrow keys as separate keys, though they are still available through a function layer.

seoDescription: Shop genuine gaming mice in Nepal: lightweight, wireless and high-DPI mice with precise sensors for FPS and MOBA games.
seoContent:
## Buy gaming mice in Nepal

In shooters and MOBAs, aim depends on a mouse that tracks precisely and feels right in your hand. Gaming mice have better sensors, faster switches and lower latency than office mice.

## How to choose a gaming mouse

- Sensor: a quality optical sensor matters more than the maximum DPI figure
- Weight: lightweight mice are easier to flick in fast shooters
- Shape and grip: palm, claw or fingertip grip suit different shapes
- Connection: wired, or 2.4 GHz wireless with gaming-grade latency
- Buttons: programmable side buttons help in MMOs and MOBAs
- Polling rate: 1000 Hz is standard; higher rates add a little extra smoothness

Pair your mouse with a good mousepad for consistent glide. All gaming mice we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: What DPI should I use for gaming?
faqs.answer: Most competitive players use between 400 and 1600 DPI and adjust in-game sensitivity. A very high DPI number on the box is less important than a reliable sensor.

faqs.question: Are wireless gaming mice as good as wired?
faqs.answer: Modern 2.4 GHz gaming mice have latency that is effectively the same as wired mice, and many pro players use them.

faqs.question: Which mouse shape is right for me?
faqs.answer: Measure your hand and think about your grip. Larger, contoured mice suit palm grip; smaller, lighter mice suit claw and fingertip grips.

seoDescription: Buy gaming mousepads in Nepal: large desk mats and speed or control surfaces for smooth, consistent mouse tracking.
seoContent:
## Buy mousepads in Nepal

A mousepad is a small upgrade with a big effect on aim. It gives your mouse sensor a consistent surface, protects your desk and makes movements smoother and more predictable.

## Types of mousepads

- Speed surfaces: low friction for fast flicks and tracking
- Control surfaces: more friction for precise stopping and small adjustments
- Extended desk mats: cover the keyboard and mouse area for a clean setup
- Hard pads: very fast glide and easy to clean

## What to look for

- A size that suits your sensitivity (low-sensitivity players need more room)
- A non-slip rubber base
- Stitched edges that stop fraying
- Thickness: thicker pads are more comfortable and forgiving on uneven desks

All mousepads we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Should I buy a large or small mousepad?
faqs.answer: If you play with low sensitivity and move your arm to aim, choose a large or extended pad. For high sensitivity or office use, a medium pad is enough.

faqs.question: Speed or control mousepad: which should I choose?
faqs.answer: Speed pads suit tracking-heavy games and fast flicks. Control pads suit tactical shooters where precise stopping matters. Many players prefer a balanced surface in between.

faqs.question: How do I clean a cloth mousepad?
faqs.answer: Hand wash it with lukewarm water and mild soap, rinse well and let it dry flat completely before using it again.

seoDescription: Buy genuine Bluetooth and smart speakers in Nepal: portable, waterproof and party speakers with powerful sound and bass.
seoContent:
## Buy Bluetooth speakers in Nepal

A good speaker turns any room, rooftop or picnic into a place for music. From pocket-size portable speakers to big party speakers with deep bass, the right choice depends on where and how you listen.

## How to choose a speaker

- Size and power: small speakers for personal listening, larger ones for living rooms and gatherings
- Battery life: 10 hours or more for days out and power cuts
- Water and dust resistance: IP67 speakers survive rain, dust and splashes
- Stereo pairing: connect two speakers for wider sound
- Smart features: voice assistants and Wi-Fi streaming on smart speakers
- Connections: Bluetooth, aux input and USB-C charging

All speakers we sell are genuine, so you get the sound and battery life the brand promises.

faqs.question: How long does a Bluetooth speaker battery last?
faqs.answer: Most portable speakers last between 8 and 24 hours depending on size and volume. Playing loudly drains the battery faster. Each product page lists the brand's figures.

faqs.question: Can I connect two speakers together?
faqs.answer: Many speakers support stereo pairing or party modes with another speaker of the same brand. Check the product page for this feature.

faqs.question: Are waterproof speakers safe in the rain?
faqs.answer: Speakers rated IPX7 or IP67 can handle rain and brief immersion. Make sure the charging port is dry before you charge it.

seoDescription: Shop genuine soundbars in Nepal for clearer TV dialogue and cinematic sound, with subwoofers, Dolby Audio and HDMI ARC.
seoContent:
## Buy soundbars in Nepal

Modern TVs are slim, which leaves little room for good speakers. A soundbar fixes that: dialogue becomes clearer, music sounds fuller and movies and sports gain real impact, all from one slim unit under the TV.

## How to choose a soundbar

- Channels: 2.0 and 2.1 soundbars improve TV sound; 3.1 and above add a dedicated centre channel for clearer dialogue; 5.1 and Dolby Atmos models add surround effects
- Subwoofer: a separate wireless subwoofer adds deep bass for movies
- Connection: HDMI ARC or eARC lets your TV remote control the volume; optical and Bluetooth are alternatives
- Size: match the soundbar width to your TV for the best look
- Room size: larger rooms benefit from more power and a subwoofer

All soundbars we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: How do I connect a soundbar to my TV?
faqs.answer: The best way is HDMI ARC or eARC, which carries sound and lets you use the TV remote. If your TV does not have ARC, use an optical cable or Bluetooth.

faqs.question: Do I need a subwoofer?
faqs.answer: Not always. A subwoofer adds deep bass that makes movies and music more powerful. For news, dialogue and small rooms, a soundbar alone is often enough.

faqs.question: What is Dolby Atmos?
faqs.answer: Dolby Atmos is a surround sound format that adds height effects. Atmos soundbars use upward-firing or virtual speakers to make sound feel like it comes from above as well as around you.

faqs.question: Can I make my old TV smart?
faqs.answer: Yes. A TV box or streaming stick connected to the HDMI port adds apps like YouTube and Netflix to any TV with an HDMI input.

faqs.question: Projector or TV: which should I buy?
faqs.answer: A TV gives a brighter picture in daylight and needs no setup. A projector gives a much bigger picture for the price, and works best in a darker room.

faqs.question: What internet speed do I need for streaming?
faqs.answer: Full HD streaming generally needs around 5 Mbps and 4K needs around 25 Mbps for smooth playback, depending on the service.

seoDescription: Buy genuine smart TVs in Nepal: 4K UHD, QLED and Android/Google TVs with built-in streaming apps. Delivered across Nepal.
seoContent:
## Buy smart TVs in Nepal

A smart TV brings YouTube, Netflix and other streaming apps straight to the big screen with no extra box. Picture quality, size and the operating system all matter when choosing one.

## How to choose a smart TV

- Size: for a 4K TV, sit about 1.2 to 1.5 times the screen diagonal away; many living rooms suit 43 to 55 inches
- Resolution: 4K UHD is the standard for sizes above 43 inches
- Panel: LED is affordable, QLED adds brighter and richer colour, OLED gives perfect blacks and contrast
- HDR: HDR10 and Dolby Vision improve contrast and colour with supported content
- Smart platform: Google TV, Android TV, webOS and Tizen each have their own app stores
- Gaming: HDMI 2.1, 120 Hz and low input lag matter for PS5 and Xbox Series X

## Protect your TV

Voltage fluctuations are common in many areas, so a surge-protected extension board or voltage stabiliser is a sensible addition. All TVs we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: What size TV should I buy for my room?
faqs.answer: Measure the distance from your seat to the TV. For a 4K TV, sitting about 1.2 to 1.5 times the screen's diagonal away works well; for example, around 2 metres suits a 55-inch TV.

faqs.question: Is a 4K TV worth it?
faqs.answer: Yes for most sizes above 43 inches. YouTube, Netflix and other services offer plenty of 4K content, and 4K TVs also upscale regular HD content.

faqs.question: Does the TV include a wall mount?
faqs.answer: It varies by model. The product page lists what is included; TVs follow standard VESA mounting patterns for wall brackets.

seoDescription: Shop genuine TV boxes and streaming devices in Nepal to add YouTube, Netflix and apps to any HDMI TV, in up to 4K.
seoContent:
## Buy TV boxes and streaming devices in Nepal

A TV box is the easiest way to upgrade a TV you already own. Plug it into an HDMI port and you get streaming apps, casting from your phone and often a voice remote, without buying a new television.

## What to look for

- Resolution: 4K and HDR support if your TV is 4K
- Platform: Google TV and Android TV boxes give access to the Google Play app store
- Performance: enough RAM and storage for apps and smooth menus
- Wi-Fi: dual-band Wi-Fi or an Ethernet port for steady streaming
- Remote: a voice remote makes searching much faster
- Casting: built-in Chromecast lets you send videos from your phone

All TV boxes we sell are genuine and come with their official software.

faqs.question: Will a TV box work with my old TV?
faqs.answer: Yes, as long as the TV has an HDMI port. If your TV is Full HD, a 4K box will still work and play at your TV's resolution.

faqs.question: Do I need a subscription to use a TV box?
faqs.answer: The box itself needs no subscription. Free apps like YouTube work straight away; paid services such as Netflix need their own subscription.

faqs.question: Can I cast from my phone to a TV box?
faqs.answer: Boxes with built-in Chromecast let you cast from YouTube and many other apps on Android and iPhone.

seoDescription: Buy genuine projectors in Nepal for home cinema, gaming, classrooms and offices: Full HD, 4K and portable smart projectors.
seoContent:
## Buy projectors in Nepal

A projector gives you a 100-inch picture or bigger for less than a large TV costs. It is perfect for movie nights, watching football with friends, gaming on a huge screen, classrooms and office presentations.

## How to choose a projector

- Brightness: measured in ANSI lumens; higher brightness copes better with room light
- Resolution: native 1080p for sharp home cinema, 4K for the most detail; check the native resolution, not just supported input
- Throw distance: short-throw projectors make a big picture from close to the wall
- Smart features: built-in apps and Wi-Fi remove the need for a separate streaming box
- Audio: built-in speakers are fine for small rooms; connect a soundbar for cinema sound
- Portability: battery-powered mini projectors are great for travel and outdoor screenings

A plain white wall works, but a projector screen improves contrast. All projectors we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Can I use a projector in daylight?
faqs.answer: It is possible with a bright projector, but the picture is best in a dark or dim room. Curtains make a big difference.

faqs.question: What does native resolution mean?
faqs.answer: Native resolution is the actual number of pixels the projector shows. Some budget projectors accept a 4K or 1080p signal but display it at a lower native resolution, so check the native figure.

faqs.question: Do I need a projector screen?
faqs.answer: A smooth, white or light grey wall works well for casual use. A proper screen gives a brighter, more uniform picture.
